title: Copying a Zscaler Client Connector App Profile

blocks.text: You can copy an existing Zscaler Client Connector App Profile and change the settings to customize the profile to fit your needs instead of having to configure each setting in a profile. By duplicating an existing profile, you can test a profile before deploying it to reduce mistakes.
To copy a Zscaler Client Connector App Profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Select OS.
Click the Copy icon next to the profile you want to copy.

blocks.text: You cannot copy the default profile.
The Copy <Platform> Policy window is displayed.

blocks.item: (Optional) Enter a new name in the Name field.
Make changes to settings as desired.

blocks.text: Your copied profile appears under the profile you copied.
You can copy a maximum of 10 profiles at the same time.
